outcome: proportion of hospitals providing maternity care services
number of FPs providing maternity care
number of FPs performing cesarean deliveries
cohort: Rural hospitals in 15 geographically diverse states with significant rural areas in 2013 to 2014
finding: The study found that family physicians (FPs) continue to provide the majority of maternity care services in US rural hospitals, including cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: The study found that among FPs with privileges in hospitals providing maternity care, a mean of 66% performed cesarean deliveries, highlighting the role of FPs in surgical obstetric care in rural areas.
